title: Plural adjective agreement in partitive
focus: Before a plural partitive noun, put the adjective in plural partitive too: Etsin pieniä kirjoja. — I am looking for small books. Both words share the case and number; their endings do not have to look alike.

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am looking for big cars.” Etsin ____ autoja.
exercises.explanation: An adjective directly describing this plural partitive noun also takes plural partitive. Match case and number, not just the last letter. Keep iso and add -ja: iso + ja = isoja.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Plural adjective agreement in partitive: form or use confused

optionFeedback.isoja: An adjective directly describing this plural partitive noun also takes plural partitive. Match case and number, not just the last letter. Keep iso and add -ja: iso + ja = isoja.
optionFeedback.isot: isot is not the required partitive form for this meaning. An adjective directly describing this plural partitive noun also takes plural partitive. Match case and number, not just the last letter.
optionFeedback.isoa: isoa does not express the requested case and number here. Keep iso and add -ja: iso + ja = isoja.
